entries.title: Sorting

entries.title: Array
entries.summary: Static and dynamic (resizable) arrays: search, insert, remove.

entries.title: Linked List, Stack, Queue, Deque
entries.summary: Singly and doubly linked lists, stacks, queues and deques: every pointer change shown.

entries.title: Hash Table
entries.summary: Hashing with linear probing, quadratic probing, double hashing and separate chaining.

entries.title: Binary Search Tree and AVL Tree
entries.summary: Search, insert and delete in a BST; AVL rotations that keep it balanced.

entries.title: Binary Heap (Priority Queue)
entries.summary: Insert, extract-max, build-heap and heap sort on a binary heap.

entries.title: Union-Find Disjoint Sets
entries.summary: Union by rank and path compression, step by step.

entries.title: Segment Tree
entries.summary: Range minimum, maximum and sum queries with updates.

entries.title: Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree)
entries.summary: Prefix sums and range updates with a Fenwick tree.

entries.title: Graph Data Structures
entries.summary: The same graph as an adjacency matrix, an adjacency list and an edge list.

entries.title: Graph Traversal (DFS and BFS)
entries.summary: Depth-first and breadth-first search, topological sort, bipartite check, bridges and strongly connected components.

entries.title: Minimum Spanning Tree
entries.summary: Kruskal's and Prim's algorithms on your own graph.

entries.title: Single-Source Shortest Paths
entries.summary: Bellman-Ford, Dijkstra, BFS and dynamic programming on DAGs.

entries.title: Network Flow
entries.summary: Ford-Fulkerson, Edmonds-Karp and Dinic; max flow and min cut.

entries.title: Graph Matching
entries.summary: Bipartite and general matching with augmenting paths.

entries.title: Minimum Vertex Cover
entries.summary: Exact and approximate vertex cover on small graphs.

entries.title: Steiner Tree
entries.summary: Steiner tree problem variants on small graphs.

entries.title: Travelling Salesperson Problem
entries.summary: Brute force and dynamic programming for TSP on small graphs.

entries.title: Recursion Tree and DAG
entries.summary: Draw the recursion tree of your own function; see overlapping subproblems and memoisation.

entries.title: Suffix Tree
entries.summary: Build a suffix tree; pattern search and longest repeated substring.

entries.title: Suffix Array
entries.summary: Suffix array and LCP array; string matching.

entries.title: Polygon
entries.summary: Perimeter, area, convexity and point-in-polygon tests on your own polygon.

entries.title: Convex Hull
entries.summary: Graham scan, Andrew's monotone chain and Jarvis march.

entries.title: Cycle-Finding
entries.summary: Floyd's tortoise and hare and Brent's algorithm.

entries.title: Bitmask
entries.summary: Set operations with bits: set, clear, toggle, lowest bit.

entries.title: NP-hard reductions
entries.summary: Reductions between NP-hard problems, shown on examples.

entries.title: CNN Explainer

entries.title: Seeing Theory: compound probability

entries.title: Seeing Theory: probability distributions

entries.title: Seeing Theory: frequentist inference

entries.title: Seeing Theory: Bayesian inference

entries.title: Seeing Theory: regression analysis
